exact_reproduction.reason: Original cohort IDs, denominator, and several protocol details are unresolved from the supplied materials.

independent_internal_comparison.evidence: Four predefined local cohort variants (plus C(9,7)=36 prone combinatorics) were evaluated with 33 fresh provenance-valid caches, formal TOST equivalence tests (delta=+-0.50 bpm, alpha=0.05, p_TOST<=0.0456 across all 4 cohorts; delta=+-0.25 bpm passed on PAPER_18 and Retained-23), 10,000-resample BCa/clustered bootstrap intervals, and a controlled single-thread timing benchmark (6.11-6.43x filter speedup, 9.16x core solver speedup).
independent_internal_comparison.claim_allowed: HPSS is formally TOST-equivalent to NMF within +-0.50 bpm (alpha=0.05) across all 4 cohort variants (and within +-0.25 bpm on PAPER_18 and Retained-23) while running 6.1-6.4x faster (9.2x core solver) in this internal reconstruction.

generalizable_superiority.reason: No untouched external dataset/site/device validation has been run.

clinical_superiority.reason: No clinical utility endpoint, prospective workflow study, safety analysis, or target-hardware validation is available.
